method: Three processes, rotated mode order, warm OS caches. Equal Python validation. cppyy_shared/pybind11/nanobind call same shared C++ kernel. Plain/cached compile same source; Rust ports same scalar formula. Five adaptive batches per size/contract; per-call p95 pools 6000 samples for N<=1000 or 600 for larger inputs. Fixed reused buffers; data and code caches warm. No CPU affinity, shared workstation, single-thread BLAS. Raw timing includes timer overhead.
